items.title: Henry A. "Hank" Kmen Interview, 1963-02-13
items.q: I remember when I went to New York, Miff Mole was around, and much respected already

ctx.x: No, I think that, well I think that people look up to him, musicians and fans, more than any other man in that band.

I'm quite sure of that. But I remember when I went to New York, Miff Mole was around, and much respected already, and then there was a guy that they called Little Miff. I can't recall now who he was, but there was another Tramone player that they used to call Little Miff Mole. Little Miff at least.

Who are some of the people from that era who you think have been, I'm getting off of New Orleans again, which I wanted to stick with, but while we're at it, who are some of the people who have kind of forgotten, we talked about Hutch and Ryder before we ever had the tape machine on, as being one of the ones who's kind of forgotten.
